<b>Gloomsacs</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are small, flying creatures native to [[The Abyss (Silksong)|the Abyss]] able to suck nutrients out of their prey.<ref>Gloomsac Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Tiny empty creature, barely a bug. Swallows its prey whole and sucks their nutrients until nothing remains."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
When they are not summoned by a [[Gargant Gloom]], Gloomsacs start off inactive and hanging from the ceiling in specific locations around the upper parts of [[The Abyss (Silksong)|the Abyss]]. Once Hornet gets near, they shake and burst off the ceiling, spinning before they begin to target Hornet. They fly any distance to get in range to attack Hornet. 
To attack, the Gloomsac rears back slightly, dashes at Hornet in a slghtly curved trajectory, and latches onto her top half if any contact is made during the dash, stopping if Hornet gets behind it or it hits a wall. It deals {{Damage|1}} every 1.2 seconds that it remains latched onto Hornet, and ATTACK or movement inputs must be pressed three times to escape. Gloomsacs deal at least {{Damage|1+1}} before Hornet can escape. Mashing out of a Gloomsac's attack instantly kills it.

When not attacking, Gloomsacs deal {{Damage|1}} on contact.

== Location ==
Gloomsacs can be found exclusively in [[The Abyss (Silksong)|the Abyss]]. They can also be summoned by [[Gargant Gloom]]s.

== Trivia ==
* Gloomsacs do not respond to the Needolin.
* If Hornet enters another room while latched onto by a Gloomsac, the Gloomsac will disappear after the room transition.
